product_one_liner.value: Maximum provides an AI-native core banking operating system that helps banks automate operational workflows, monitor customer activity in real time, and build financial products.

pricing_page.notes: No pricing link or plans were found; /pricing returns the homepage rather than a pricing page.

named_customers.notes: Fewer than two customer names were verified. Emprise Bank is the one named implementation/design customer found; the cited announcement describes its selection of Maximum and planned migration. Empty list follows the requested two-customer threshold, not an absence of customers.

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 11 employees as of 2026-11-09.

eng_blog.notes: No blog belonging to the current banking company was located; legacy employer-branding content was excluded.

public_docs.notes: No public documentation, help-center or developer-portal link was found on the official site; technical descriptions in job postings are not product documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The listed roles are Senior Staff Software Engineer, Staff Software Engineer and Senior Software Engineer; none has a qualifying AI, ML or data-science title.

model_provider.notes: No publicly named production model or model provider was found after checking product material, careers, newsroom and privacy disclosures and searching for docs, AI/security FAQs and subprocessors.

compliance_certs.notes: The privacy policy describes general security safeguards but names none of SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR or PCI DSS as a certification or compliance claim.

last_funding.notes: 2026-08 is the public announcement month, not a verified closing month. Pear’s 2026-08-03 post says the round was raised eight months earlier, and Emprise’s October announcement says it closed late in 2025; an exact closing month was not verified.

raised_18mo.notes: The $30 million seed round closed in late 2025 and was publicly announced on 2026-08-03, within the 2025-05-09 through 2026-11-09 window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The public careers page lists only software-engineering roles, with no qualifying SDR, BDR or account-executive title.

launched_6mo.notes: Maximum publicly emerged from stealth on 2026-08-03; its investor said it was bringing its ledger and AI-powered core to market with initial bank customers coming onboard. This is the public product introduction, not a claim that all bank migrations were already live.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Alex Steiner’s profile lists joining as Chief Revenue Officer in August 2026; Andrew Dust’s profile lists joining as Chief Operating Officer in August 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The readable job postings name no CRM, sales-engagement or marketing-automation system; this does not establish that the company uses none internally.
